messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty triggered: GPU memory pressure detected in pool 'gpu-pool-prod-3'. Multiple CUDA out-of-memory errors reported across hosts. See alert: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/PD-INC-4821

pagerduty: Triggered PD-INC-4821 - Severity: P1 - GPU memory pressure / CUDA OOM spikes

Lee: acked - I'm on it :wave:

Alex R.: grabbing console and logs. Any immediate customer impact flagged?

Maria Chen: ML infra here — yes, we see elevated 502s for /generate and /embed. Error rate up ~6% over baseline in the last 3m. Also seeing several large seq-length requests and a heavy nightly batch job hitting the prod pool.

Sanjay Patel: quick context: kernel logs show allocation failures. dmesg snippet from node-65:
```
[12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID=27189, GPU memory allocation failed
[12345.679002] cuda: out of memory when allocating 512MB
```

Lee: checklist — 1) identify top memory consumers 2) evict/cordon offending jobs 3) restart runtime if needed 4) scale pool 5) assess customer impact. Alex, can you run top mem consumers?

Alex R.: running `kubectl top pods --namespace=ml-serving --sort-by=memory | head -n 20` — found `model-batch-encoder-7` using ~38Gi on gpu-pool-prod-3, long-running pod not autoscaled.

Maria Chen: that batch job should be non-prod. Looks like a bad label from last night's CI run. Owner unclear yet.

Sanjay Patel: I'm going to cordon node-65 and restart containerd to reclaim any leaked GPU allocations. Commands I'll run:
```
ssh node-65
sudo systemctl restart containerd
# then check nvidia-smi
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv
```

ops-monitoring-bot: node-65 containerd restart completed; GPU memory usage dropped from ~36Gi to 2.1Gi.

Lee: good. Eviction + restart helped node-65. node-66 and node-68 still showing pressure. Suggest: scale up pool by 2 nodes (hot add), enable auto-shedder to block big batch jobs from prod pool, and open bridge if we confirm customer impact.

Maria Chen: scaling autoscaling group `ag-gpu-prod` +2 nodes now — provisioning ETA ~90s.

Alex R.: I'll add a temporary taint to prevent batch jobs landing on prod nodes: `kubectl taint nodes -l pool=gpu-prod batch-block=true:NoSchedule`

pagerduty: PD-INC-4821 acknowledged by Lee at 1723456793

Lee: tagging @data-team — can you confirm owner of that `model-batch-encoder-7` job? Maria, can you surface the job owner?

Maria Chen: owner shows as `data-pipelines` (ci:build-3241). Adding them into the thread.

Sanjay Patel: observed nvlink warnings on node-68; may be hardware degradation rather than pure scheduling. Filing with infra-hardware to run diagnostics.

ops-monitoring-bot: autoscale +2 nodes completed; new nodes joined gpu-pool-prod-3. Overall GPU utilization across pool dropped to nominal levels.

Lee: Customer impact summary: small increase in failed requests related to embedding/generation endpoints, affecting approximately 3 customers (high traffic) — roughly 0.04% of overall requests during the spike window. Not a full outage but needs SLA note. Maria, can you draft an impact blurb?

Maria Chen: Draft: "Between 17:06–17:12 UTC, a subset of requests to generation and embedding endpoints experienced elevated 502 errors due to GPU memory pressure on several production nodes. We performed evictions, node restarts, and a temporary autoscale which mitigated the errors. No data exposure is suspected. Root cause and remediation are under investigation; a follow-up RCA will be shared."

Alex R.: I'll mark the offending nodes `NoSchedule` for batch jobs until infra confirms hardware is healthy. Also creating a short-term firewall in routing to divert large seq-length jobs to dedicated infra.

Sanjay Patel: filed infra ticket HAR-4821 for hardware diagnostics: https://infra/internal/har/4821. Oncall-hw will pick it up.

data-pipelines: thanks — we shipped a job with the wrong k8s labels in CI; we'll revert and re-run on non-prod. Sorry about the accidental push.

Lee: Handoff plan: I'll remain primary until 17:40 UTC and then hand to Maria for RCA and customer comms. Sanjay to coordinate hardware follow-up. If no more OOMs in 10m we can resolve PD.

ops-monitoring-bot: alert stream quieting. Error rate for /embed down to ~1.2% (near baseline).

incident-bot: PD-INC-4821 auto-resolved at 1723456950

Alex R.: confirming metrics stable. Will open RCA doc and attach logs.

Maria Chen: I'll create RCA ticket, include fixes: enforce pool-label validation in CI, prevent batch jobs from scheduling on prod pools, and add pre-deploy check for sequence-length distribution.

Lee: thanks everyone. Good triage. Closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
